## What and why

One or two sentences on what changes and the reason for it.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] Docs updated where the behavior changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] No em dash in any Markdown file
- [ ] No banned vocabulary, in code or comments, from the list in `scripts/check-prose.sh`
